name: MSI GS66 Stealth 10SE
provenance: isw (YoyPa/isw) [16V1EMS1] section + its MSI_ADDRESS_DEFAULT profile, which carries a real EC dump from a GS66-10SE
teackot/msi-ec CONF_G1_3, which explicitly lists "16V1EMS1.118 // GS66 Stealth 10SE"
in-tree drivers/platform/x86/msi-ec.c charge-control semantics (the start and end thresholds are one EC byte, always 10% apart)
Tachometer constant RPM = 478000 / period, reproduced verbatim from isw and confirmed on hardware 2026-10-16 (Cooler Boost drives 0xcc from ~3700 to ~8100, the top of this laptop's range)
notes: Step function: the fan runs at speeds[0] until the temperature passes temps[0], then speeds[1], and so on, so 6 thresholds and 7 speeds. Cooler Boost does NOT update the duty registers (with boost on, 0x71/0x89 stayed at 70 while the tachometers read ~8100 RPM), so fan_pct is what the curve asks for, not what the fan is doing. 0xc8 is not a third fan: it does not follow the fans under Cooler Boost. The graphics-mode (MUX) addresses are deliberately not in this file because they are not GS66-specific -- the whole model family shares one MUX block in src/msi_control.py, and this model only sets "mux": true.
